about: Factors for desk/footprint.py. Each was read on the page in url on asOf. A row without a url is never used. low/high are the range shown on the page.

grid_vn.source: Our World in Data / Ember: carbon intensity of electricity
grid_vn.note: Vietnam 2025 461 g/kWh; low 2022; high a 2024 national grid study (0.681)

us_grid.note: eGRID2023 US total output rate 770.9 lb CO2e/MWh

datacenter_pue.note: Google fleet 1.09; high = Uptime 2025 industry average 1.54

mac_laptop_w.note: Display-on idle 3.1-4.0 W; high = Mac mini M4 maximum 65 W

digital_kwh_per_hour.note: Network 23% + data centres 5% of 0.077 kWh per hour of streaming (2019)

llm_wh_per_1k_output_tokens.note: 0.3 Wh (0.1-4) per query of about 500 output tokens
